episodes.title: Keeping Your Heart with Cult Survivor, Nurse, and Mother, Autumn Cotten Part 1 | November 2026
episodes.description:
Nurse Autumn Cotten grew up in a cult that robbed her of passion, education, and altered the trajectory of her life. After breaking free, she achieved an impossible goal by completing her education and becoming a nurse. Starting in trauma at the height of COVID-19 before moving into labor and delivery, her perspective is especially unique.

Thank you Nurse Autumn for sharing your story with Writer Wait
Stay tuned for part 2 (which included better audio). The 2026 Fourth Quarter Playlist for Writer Wait will continue to grow throughout December.
